title: The upholstered furniture brand's New York showroom
assumptions: The same brand's Manhattan showroom, formed as a New York company; the imports are filed by the Los Angeles importer of record, so no import filing is part of this opening. The filings are those of strict/nyc-bakery-cafe.json and gold/flushing-beer-wine.json without the food steps. No official New York page read states a license or registration for upholstered furniture, so none is claimed.
